India is a huge country with 28 states and 8 Union Territories, hundreds of languages, and countless cultures, religions, traditions, and ways of life. 🇮🇳
Please show the problems and criticize them—India absolutely has issues that need attention. But one slum, one community, or one unusual tradition cannot represent an entire country.
I’m from Kerala, and even I learn about many of these things through documentaries because we don’t experience them in our daily lives. When only this side of India is shown, people outside India may think the whole country is garbage. That is simply not India.India is unity in diversity. Show the good, show the bad, criticize what needs criticism—but please show India as the incredibly diverse country. it truly is. 🇮🇳❤️
